name: lake-tahoe-3d-trail-explorer-static-vanilla-js
description: Photorealistic 3D Map Explorer, Camera Tour & 3D Trail Route in Lake Tahoe built with Static HTML, Vanilla ES Modules, and Google Maps Platform (Maps 3D, Places API New, Elevation API).

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const f of ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'server.mjs']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing static asset: ' + f); } console.log('Static build verification passed.'); })"
